methods.label: Find the actual dimensions and multiply
methods.explanation: The actual length is \(5\times200=1000\) cm \(=10\) m, and the actual width is \(3\times200=600\) cm \(=6\) m. The area is \(10\times6=60\text{ m}^2\).
